description: Owner navigates to Staff Accounts tab
expected: Staff directory renders with existing active staff members (Ananya Verma, Suresh Kumar)
actual: Verified: Staff directory rendered with full employee list

description: Owner creates new delivery associate "Deepak Courier"
expected: Account created and listed in directory with role "delivery" and status "Active"
actual: Verified: Deepak Courier created and active in staff directory

description: Active delivery staff appears in Assign Courier modal options
expected: Deepak Courier is available for assignment in delivery staff list
actual: Verified: Deepak Courier listed as selectable courier in assignment modal

description: Owner toggles Deepak Courier to Deactivated
expected: Staff account status flips to Deactivated; status badge updates in UI
actual: Verified: Deepak Courier is now marked Deactivated

description: Deactivated staff is excluded from active assignment dropdowns
expected: Deepak Courier does not appear in assignment modal ([Suresh Kumar] only)
actual: Verified: Deactivated staff excluded from courier assignment list

description: Deactivated staff member attempts to access portal (/delivery)
expected: ProtectedRoute intercepts and renders Account Deactivated notice; operational portal blocked
actual: Verified: Portal blocked with Account Deactivated view

description: Owner account card provides protection against self-deactivation and self-deletion
expected: No clickable Deactivate or Delete button on authenticated owner account; displays protected badge
actual: Verified: Authenticated owner card is fully protected against self-deactivation and deletion

description: Owner creates new delivery associate profile in database
expected: Profile row created with role="delivery", is_active=true
actual: Created: Rohit Courier, Role: delivery, Active: true

description: Owner updates employee role from "delivery" to "manager"
Customer attempts to elevate their own role to owner
expected: Profile update blocked by RLS/Trigger, role remains "customer"

description: current_user_role() returns NULL for inactive employee (disabling all role permissions)
expected: public.current_user_role() returns NULL when is_active = false
actual: Role returned for inactive user: NULL (Safely Deactivated)

description: delete_staff_profile safely deboards staff with past order attributions (deactivated_instead = true)
expected: RPC returns deactivated_instead: true; profile preserved with is_active=false, order foreign key intact
actual: deboarded: true, profile is_active: false, assigned_delivery_id intact: true

description: delete_staff_profile permanently removes staff with no operational records (deactivated_instead = false)
expected: RPC returns deactivated_instead: false; profile row permanently removed from profiles table

description: Owner attempts to invoke delete_staff_profile on their own account
expected: Database raises exception: "You cannot delete your own authenticated owner account."
actual: Exception caught: "You cannot delete your own authenticated owner account."

description: Attempting to delete permanent primary owner account (superwashexprez@gmail.com)
expected: Database raises exception: "Access denied. The permanent primary owner account (superwashexprez@gmail.com) cannot be deleted."
actual: Exception caught: "Access denied. The permanent primary owner account (superwashexprez@gmail.com) cannot be deleted."
